name: web-swiss-style-portfolio-boards-with-isometric-laptop-and-color-font-specs
title: Monochrome Swiss-style portfolio: isometric laptop and phone with giant WELCOME, guide ticks, and black colour and font panels
whatItIs: A tall white board with an isometric black laptop and phone showing a giant cropped geometric 'WELCOME' with vertical tick guides and a smartwatch mockup, a full-width page with the same giant word, tiny nav links and 'swiss style' in grey, and a black footer with 'colors' (black and white swatch) and 'fonts' (Bruno Ace, Actay).
whatItMeans: Precise and confident; a two-colour system and one bold word feel architectural.
techniques: Show the site on a floating isometric laptop and phone.
Use a giant cropped word with guide ticks.
Document colours and fonts in a black band.

vocabulary.definition: A palette of only black and white.
A section naming the typefaces used.
